records.natural_product_context: Primary paper introduction cites original1991 isolation of cornexistin from Paecilomyces variotii SANK21086. Original isolation source has not been independently reviewed in this pilot; the bound diacid is not automatically a separate naturally isolated compound.
records.limits: Bound UP0 is hydrolyzed C16H22O7 rather than parent C16H20O6. Connectivity is checked by anhydride opening without erasing the two exact InChIKeys; geometry/stereochemical relation still needs source review. 8EL is a thiamine-related cofactor and is not the inhibitor. Protein source Zea mays differs from E.coli expression host. Crop-protein structure does not establish weed-target efficacy or organism safety; affinity fields remain unknown.
